description: Reconstructing a cache record from persisted flat records covering boundary inputs: a record that omits the key column so the key falls back to the URL, an explicitly empty key column that is retained, a zero and a negative validity timestamp, a very large numeric id, non-ASCII URL and entity-tag text, and records that omit the relative path and entity-tag columns so those fields read back absent.
